mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torn_stocks WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT stocks_id AS stocksId, MIN(stocks_shortname) AS stocksShortname, MIN(reg_date_time) AS earliestMinute, MAX(reg_date_time) AS latestMinute, COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('minute', reg_date_time)) AS minuteCount FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY stocks_id ORDER BY stocks_id

SELECT data_source AS source, COUNT(*) AS count FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY data_source ORDER BY data_source

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} AND current_price IS NOT NULL AND current_price > 0 AND total_shares IS NOT NULL AND total_shares >= 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT stocks_id, date_trunc('minute', reg_date_time) AS minute_time FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY stocks_id, date_trunc('minute', reg_date_time) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_groups

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) FROM ( SELECT stocks_id, date_trunc('minute', reg_date_time) AS minute_time, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY stocks_id, date_trunc('minute', reg_date_time) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_groups

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} AND (current_price IS NULL OR current_price <= 0 OR total_shares IS NULL OR total_shares < 0)

WITH minute_slots AS ( SELECT stocks_id, date_trunc('minute', reg_date_time) AS minute_time FROM torn_stocks_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND reg_date_time >= #{startInclusive} AND reg_date_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY stocks_id, date_trunc('minute', reg_date_time) ), with_prev AS ( SELECT stocks_id, minute_time, LAG(minute_time) OVER ( PARTITION BY stocks_id ORDER BY minute_time ) AS prev_minute FROM minute_slots ), gaps AS ( SELECT stocks_id, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (minute_time - prev_minute)) / 60 - 1) AS gap_minutes FROM with_prev WHERE prev_minute IS NOT NULL AND minute_time - prev_minute > interval '1 minute' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS gapSegmentCount, COALESCE(MAX(gap_minutes::bigint), 0) AS maxGapMinutes FROM gaps

SELECT effective_month AS effectiveMonth, state_status AS stateStatus, manual_override AS manualOverride, COUNT(*) AS count FROM torn_stock_monthly_state WHERE deleted = 0 AND effective_month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{startInclusive})::date AND effective_month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{endExclusive} - INTERVAL '1 microsecond')::date GROUP BY effective_month, state_status, manual_override ORDER BY effective_month, state_status, manual_override

SELECT COALESCE(metric_snapshot->>'incompleteReason', 'UNKNOWN') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM torn_stock_monthly_state WHERE deleted = 0 AND effective_month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{startInclusive})::date AND effective_month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', #{endExclusive} - INTERVAL '1 microsecond')::date AND state_status = 'DRAFT' GROUP BY metric_snapshot->>'incompleteReason' ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT round_status AS roundStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM torn_stock_market_round WHERE deleted = 0 AND round_time >= #{startInclusive} AND round_time < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY round_status ORDER BY round_status

SELECT setting_key AS settingKey, setting_value AS settingValue FROM sys_setting WHERE deleted = 0 AND setting_key IN ( 'VIP_STOCK_ALERT_ENABLED', 'VIP_STOCK_NEW_ENTRY_ENABLED', 'VIP_STOCK_FORMAL_NOTICE_ENABLED', 'VIP_STOCK_DAILY_SUMMARY_ENABLED', 'VIP_STOCK_RULE_MODE' ) ORDER BY setting_key
